rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing Ordinance (proposed SDMC Division 11)
rules.requirement: Prohibits any person from selling, licensing, or otherwise providing an algorithmic device that uses nonpublic competitor data to recommend rental rates or occupancy levels to a landlord, and prohibits landlords from using such a device to set rents or occupancy levels for residential rental property. Each month and each property counts as a separate violation; tenants may sue for injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, plus attorney's fees.
rules.key_value: Ban on sale/licensing/use; civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation

exemption_conditions.condition: Software or product that publishes reports on rental rates or occupancy levels from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old, or from public information, and does not recommend rates or occupancy levels for future leases or renewals, is not an algorithmic device.
value: aggregated reporting software using data more than 90 days old or public information, without recommendations

exemption_conditions.condition: Software or product used to establish rental rates or income limits in accordance with local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines is not an algorithmic device.
value: affordable housing program rent/income limit software

coverage.notes: Applies to persons selling/licensing/providing algorithmic devices to landlords, and to landlords using them for residential rental property in the City of San Diego.

rules.coverage_text: Applies to any person who sells, licenses, or provides algorithmic devices to landlords, and to landlords who use such devices to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property in the City of San Diego.
rules.exemptions: Excluded from the definition of algorithmic device: (a) software publishing reports from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old or from public information that does not recommend rates or occupancy levels for future leases or renewals; (b) software used to establish rental rates or income limits under local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines.

effective_dates.raw: on the thirtieth day from and after its final passage
effective_dates.quoted_span:
This Ordinance will take effect and be in force on the thirtieth day from
and after its final passage.

rules.interaction: The remedies are cumulative and are in addition to any other remedies at law, statute, or ordinance.
citation_aliases: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing Ordinance
San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 11
rules.quoted_span:
(a) It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an
algorithmic device to a landlord.
(b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates
or occupancy levels for residential rental property.

llm.notes: The document is a February 27, 2025 staff report with a proposed ordinance (O-2025-107). The final passage date and ordinance number are blank, so it is recorded as bill_pending.
